meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 装上后,你提交一段现成的讲话/访谈/播客视频,它会先转出带时间的文字稿,再按内容叠上设计好的图形卡片(标题、人名条、数据、引言、画中画等),时间与台词同步,原视频画面不动,最后输出 MP4(画布可选 16:9、9:16、4:5)。
howto.when: 你要给现成讲话/访谈/播客视频加图形卡片或做包装时(可说 graphic overlays、package video 等)触发;纯字幕另有技能处理,拿不准交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这段访谈视频加上开场标题、人名条和数据卡片,最后导出 MP4。
say.note: 先转出文字稿,再按台词时间点叠卡片并渲染。

say.text: 把这段播客视频重排成 9:16 竖版,亮点金句做成引言卡片。
say.note: 会按竖屏画布重新排卡片与时间。

say.text: 把视频里的关键数字做成数据卡,重点段落加画中画。
say.note: 卡片数与节奏会按视频时长和密度自动估算。

howto.what_en: Packages an existing talking-head/interview/podcast clip with timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) synced to its transcript and renders the composition to MP4; the source video plays untouched below.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to package/dress up an existing talking-head/interview/podcast clip with graphic overlays or on-screen graphics. Plain-subtitle requests go to another skill.

say_en.text: Add titles, lower-thirds and data cards to this clip; export an MP4.
say_en.note: It transcribes, then times and renders each card.

say_en.text: Re-lay this podcast as 9:16 vertical; turn highlights into quote cards.
say_en.note: Cards are laid out for the vertical canvas.

say_en.text: Turn the key numbers in this video into data cards; add PiP on key sections.
say_en.note: Pacing and card count follow duration and density.
